tables.caption: Table 1-1: Sectors and Descriptions
rows:
Activities undertaken by the government to facilitate financial support and trade with
international economies and related to the conduct and implementation of policies, aid
programs, treaties, and diplomatic relations.

Corresponds to the research, maintenance, equipment, procurement, and development of
forces, weapons, and related entities. This also comprises remuneration and benefits paid to all
active and non-active civilians and personnel.

General Government
(Customer Service,
Customer Operations)
and Local Services

The provision of general customer services and operations including registrations, licensing,
applications, workforce planning, social services, management of labor rights, and local
services.

Educational programs that correspond to early years, primary school, secondary school, higher
education, and specialist schooling; children’s social services, safeguarding, and associated
children and adolescent services; and skill or training activities undertaken by the government
to promote education.

Encompasses medical and nursing governance, strategy and care services provided to
individuals and families, research, and the provision of hospital and community services to
safeguard mental and physical health.

Covers the total cost of judiciary, prosecution, expenses connected with funding protection, law
enforcement services, and the cost of criminal justice including incarceration, supervision,
parole, and rehabilitation of prisoners.

Maintains controls over public spending, revenue, financial reporting, auditing, and providing
the direction for future investment decisions and financial planning.

Activities that ensure natural and urban environment responsibility, provision of core
infrastructure, and protection of citizens’ standards of living and safety through the licensing
and enforcement of regulation.

Involves the development of policy across the government, the provision of statistics for
population and performance against benchmarks to ensure continuous improvement, and
incorporates strategic and long-term planning to identify future risks, opportunities, and
solutions.

negotiating partnerships and agreements.

diplomatic assistance and conducting consultations with
international governments.

Activities that maintain relationships with international
governments by monitoring existing treaties and
negotiating partnerships and formal agreements.

tables.caption: Table 3-1: Sector: Defense and Security
rows:
Programs leveraged by national defense that include defense-related activities, threat reduction, and
counter-terrorism.

Corresponds to all miscellaneous defense-related events
(e.g., expenses related to procurement external to national
defense).

Corresponds to the activities to reduce and prevent the
spread of goods or confidential data related to threats. This
will include data exploitation, effective information
maneuver, and cybersecurity operations.

Includes domestic and international responses that
correspond to the elimination and deterrence of acts of
terrorism.

Maintenance, equipment, procurement, and development of forces, infrastructure, remuneration,
and benefits paid to personnel.

Corresponds to the improvement of individuals and
collective performance within defense through real-life
tasks and functions and simulated training environments
to integrate the use of maneuver and engagement
activities.

Includes activities used to achieve defense objectives in all
environments through amalgamation of the use of
engagement and maneuver.

Corresponds to the movement of information in order to
satisfy the connectivity and interoperability needs of the
defense.

Includes all activities that ensure the security of and
protect the general population, government, and leaders.
Activities to protect, analyze, and comprehend the needs and interests of the government and allies.

Corresponds to all activities used to protect the
government’s interests and respond to potential threats by
exploiting cross-governmental IT infrastructure, networks,
and information.

Includes all activities that encompass the ability to analyze
and comprehend the needs of the government and
citizens.

Pertains to advanced services that process, analyze, and
collect information in order to support national interests.

rows: Provides assistance and advice to the users of the services.

Refers to the provision of individuals who are responsible
for dealing with incoming enquiries and oversee general

government and local government to achieve strategic
goals.

rows: The functions that directly engage the public.

Undertakes the responsibility for the assignment of social
security numbers and administers social security
retirement, survivors, and disability insurance programs.

Addresses provision and determination of eligibility for
benefits including income-related benefits, housing
benefits, child benefits, carer benefits, and disability
benefits.

Encompasses the distribution of fixed payments
periodically to support citizens’ retirement from work.

Involves the provision of extra money to individuals on
low incomes.

Encompasses the conduct and investigation of individuals
claiming benefits to which they are not entitled.

Includes the ability to assess and address individuals’
dissatisfaction with customer operations.

Provides guidance, support, and information for
individuals looking to return to work following a career
break.
Provides services within a specific location or community.

Oversees the registration of births, marriages, and deaths
in the local community.

Refers to the provision of information and
recommendations to local community groups on budget
and legal issues, and general advice on local projects and
services.

The provision of an online avenue used to integrate a
community and share feedback.

The provision of grants and loans to community groups in
order to fund local projects and services.

Supports the establishment of local networks and
activities, liaises with businesses to support community
projects, and organizes activities for residents.

Provides advice and applies legal processes at town and
area level.

tables.caption: Table 5-1: Sector: Young People and Education
rows:
Corresponds to social services, and additional safeguarding, adolescent support, and parental
support in early years.

Individuals in the care of local authorities as a result of
mandatory care orders or parent agreements.

The provision of temporary or long-term responsibility of
a child to a surrogate parent.

Comprises safeguarding training, policies, and processes to
ensure all children are protected from harm.

Includes activities to offer information and support to
parents and carers to promote emotional wellbeing and
positive family relationships.

Provides activities that support the learning, development,
and care of children prior to entering schooling.

Provides support and guidance through a number of
transition stages to adulthood.

Includes the provisioning of skills and knowledge to children through schooling, education, and
adherence to national expectations and standards.

Consists of activities that provide education at an
elementary level, with focus on reading and writing.

The provision of education through secondary-level
educational establishments.

Provides extra help, adapted programs or learning
environments, specific equipment, or materials to support
students.

Comprises developing course materials, learning
materials, resources, exam material, and exam
administration that adhere to education standards and
accredit education qualifications.

Outlines mandatory courses and units to be completed and
communicates with departments to ensure consistency
across education establishments.

Supports the provision of further education and training for work-related disciplines including
apprenticeships, on-the-job training, and communications with industry and tertiary institutions.

Includes the provision of training through workplace and
traineeships.

Consists of on-the-job training amalgamated with
classroom training.

tables.caption: Table 6-1: Sector: Health and Community Wellbeing
rows: The provision of services in order to safeguard the mental and physical health of adults.

Involves activities required in order to support adults with
physical or learning difficulties.

Provides access to psychological, employment support,
trauma informed care, medicines management, and
personalized support for adults with mental health needs.

Refers to care provisioned in order to prevent illnesses or
diseases.

Involves the use of physiological methods to support and
assist adults with mental and emotional difficulties.

Involves the use of talk therapy in order to support and
assist adults with mental and emotional difficulties.

Involves protection of the physical and mental wellbeing
of community members and monitoring community
health services.

Comprises safeguarding training, policies, and processes to
ensure all adults are protected from harm.

Refers to the provision of diagnostic, technical,

qualified healthcare professionals.

The provision of hospital care and supervision for patients
for less than one night.

The provision of hospital care and supervision for patients
for at least one night.

Corresponds to the maintenance, management, and
upkeep of hospital and community facilities.

The provision of pre-hospital care including ambulances,
urgent response, and out of hospital treatment.

tables.caption: Table 7-1: Sector: Judiciary, Justice, and Home Affairs
rows:
Refers to services that protect and safeguard the public and ensure compulsory compliance
regarding the law.

Used to check for illegal goods or goods for which a tax
may be applicable, and advises on quotas and customs
regulations including inspections, cargo clearance, screen,
and search.

Monitors the status of incoming travelers from overseas to
the country to confirm that they are permitted to enter,
and ensures on-arrival clearance through the passenger
entry control system.

Provides urgent assistance in unforeseen circumstances
including emergency funding, logistical support, advises
on equipment regulations, and co-ordinates government
and community-based services.

Enables the provision of fire fighters and assistance to
extinguish fires, minimize damage, promote fire safety,
and enable emergency prevention, protection, and
response.

Consists of activities used to design, develop, and
implement health and safety programs.

Comprises activities that advise on rules and regulations,
improve public safety, and reduce violence and use of
illegal substances.
Refers to the delivery of justice to those that have committed crimes or offences.

Oversees young offenders and provisions community
services to prevent young people recommitting crimes in
the future.

Encompasses the delivery of justice to individuals who
have committed crimes and includes the provision of
prosecution lawyers.

Represents the monitoring of facilities used to detain
criminal offenders.

Consists of activities that co-ordinate law enforcement
services.

Reviews existing laws and recommends potential for
reform if necessary.

Encompasses programs that reimburse victims of crime
for expenses related to the crime.

Handles the assessment of dissatisfaction with a police
force or individual to maintain public confidence.

tables.caption: Table 8-1: Sector: Financial
rows:
Activities associated with the collection of money owed to the government from domestic and
foreign sources.

Responsible for the administration of the tax system, tax
policy development, maintenance, and implementation.

Promotes the welfare of the population through assistance
measures to help in case of instability of living and to
prevent such instability.

The collection of taxes on imports and some exports by
customs authorities.

Supports individuals and businesses towards compliance
with taxation requirements and surrendering of taxes and
levies to the government.

Activities pertaining to delivering long-term financial strategies to support future service delivery,
financial monitoring, and control.

Assesses the sustainability of current programs and
policies.

Examines internal capabilities and lays out strategies for
how to use those capabilities to meet goals.

Analyzes exposure to risk and determines appropriate
measures to ensure continued activities.

Assesses the long-term fiscal needs of the government and
acquires, allocates resources, and manages costs.

Determines where and how much capital will be spent on
investment opportunities.

Activities to identify, organize, classify, record, summarize, and communicate information of
financial transactions.

Manages business partnerships and relationships between
businesses, organizations, and individuals that contribute
to the government’s objectives.

Defines the set of capabilities to measure the effectiveness
of a government’s financial assets and capital.

Ensures that accounting information is uniform and
accounting decisions are made in a reasonable way.
